newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens unit boosts sales outlook.
newsitem.headline: Siemens unit boosts sales outlook.

text.p: The private network systems group of German electronics giant Siemens AG on Wednesday sharply revised upwards its outlook for the year 2000 to some 15 billion marks ($9.6 billion) in annual sales.
That is an increase from earlier predictions of 12 billion marks and reflects what the company called "turbulent demand" for telephone and other types of communications systems.

A company official speaking at a news conference in Munich said he expected slight growth in earnings in the business year to September 30, 1997. Orders would grow in line with sales, which were expected to expand 20 percent.
In the first quarter of its fiscal year, orders for the private networks division were higher than expected.
The company expects return on sales of between five and six percent in the next few years after 5.1 percent in 1995/96.
